answer: Require every seat to answer one surprise liveness prompt in a shared 60 second window, checked by an independent liveness oracle tracking the thread of timing and device fingerprints. One person sits only one check at a time, so 1,000 fake seats need 1,000 hired hands that minute; at $15 a head that is $15,000 a round, due every round, while an honest contributor shows up once for free. A seat that misses the window, or whose timing matches another seat's enough to show one hand behind both, loses the seat and forfeits pending rewards. A reef grows from one rock, and a horizon holds one sun.
